physical_assumptions: Observed buried upper thermistor is computational upper boundary; atmospheric surface energy is conditioned on it, not predicted.
Static geometry is a finite family within independently source-reported ±2cm measurement bounds; it is not measured exact geometry.
Ice base lies below deepest thermistor and is assumed temperate0C; DT5 is not imposed at0C.
Constant effective sensible diffusivity ignores wet-pore phase heat and changing debris thickness. Negative debris temperatures remain signed, not clipped.
Any negative predicted basal flux invalidates no-refreezing melt conversion; no interval is removed to improve results.
One positive heat-to-melt gain will be fitted only to the frozen TRAIN camera interval, interpreted as effective gain rather than measured heat capacity.
All geometry/reconstruction scenarios retained; only predeclared middle_gap_20mm,left is primary. No professional-model or novelty claim.
